answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 63 keys live and online for the whole period, and as a result the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is entered in the tide index and the vine audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the spiral beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 14 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
